content.headline: Classify first — then choose the AI
content.body: Treat every free public AI tool like an open phone line. Before you paste, ask: would I be comfortable if this exact text appeared on a public website tomorrow?
bullets: Never upload to free AI: Aadhaar / citizen IDs, FIR or evidence, Cabinet drafts, medical records, tender evaluation sheets, unpublished financials, citizen PII combos
Tier 1 Public → consumer AI is fine
Tier 2 Internal → enterprise AI with a no-training clause
Tier 3 Confidential → local / on-prem SLM only
Tier 4 Classified → air-gapped; no consumer or cloud AI
